name: feature.commerce-connect.nodes
description: Commerce Connect feature node pack (ADR 0385) — a READ-ONLY seller-stats node over the ctx.features['commerce-connect'] surface. Onboarding, purchase, refunds, and approval are deliberately NOT nodes: money movement + human gates stay privileged REST (the ADR 0022 'install is not a node' rule).
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Seller Stats
nodes.description: Reads the run tenant's OWN seller account state, sales aggregates, and recent payouts over ctx.features['commerce-connect'].sellerStats. Read-only; tenant-scoped by the surface; empty when the tenant is not a seller.
